title: Sentinel Trading Discord
author: Pitiful-Mode9062
selftext:
I built a rules-based trading alert system and need honest feedback  
I’ve been developing Sentinel Trading, a Discord that monitors SPY, QQQ, MAGS, the Magnificent Seven, AMD, and AVGO.  
It provides:  
• Clear ON/OFF trend signals  
• Alerts when a signal is getting close  
• Three systems designed for different trading styles.  
• Automated monitoring during market hours  
I’m looking for people to test it and give honest feedback. The first 20 members will receive free lifetime access to Sentinel Complete, which includes all three systems.  
No guaranteed returns or financial advice—just a straightforward, rules-based system designed to help remove emotion from trading.  
https://discord.gg/qvNFrZewz
